title: A perk: a passive bonus or an active ability, taken at a level-up (R6.3, D96)

class.description: The class it belongs to (an id from content/classes/), or "any" for a universal perk, offered on the levels in content/rules/levels.json.

level.description: A class perk's level. Each class has one perk at level 1 and two (a passive and an active) at each later class level, to choose between.

description.description: What it does, in a sentence or two, for the tooltip.

effects.description: The game value changes a perk brings for as long as it is held: a passive's, or an active's that works without being used (Bend Reality's doubled rift chance, D106).

cooldown.description: An active perk's cooldown: casts that count (an attempt at a catch, D96), or real milliseconds while the game is open (D32). minusLevel takes the character's level off the count.

cooldowns.description: Other abilities' cooldowns, replaced while this perk is held (Fence's for Gut, D106): ability id -> the cooldown it has instead.

repeatable.description: A universal perk that can be offered and taken again.
